purpose: Persistent verified real-PDF storage in GitHub Release assets; acquisition state and manifests remain in the governed review branch.

storage_contract.distribution: Every verified PDF is recorded once by SHA-256 in release-storage-manifest.json.
storage_contract.source_failover: immediate next independent catalogued source on restriction/failure
storage_contract.no_source_quota: the engine does not stop after a provider-specific book count

migration.legacy_lfs_pdfs: preserve until verified Release asset exists, then remove from governed branch
migration.secondary_lfs_repository: retired from the governed acquisition path; existing contents are not deleted

failure_policy: If a verified PDF cannot be uploaded and digest-verified as a Release asset, the acquisition cycle fails closed and the plaintext working PDF is not removed from the persistent state.
